rules.admission: a tier is admitted when, over the held-out images, its wrong bytes / labelled bytes <= 0.001 and no image exceeds 0.005; a tier labelling < 1000 bytes in total is admitted only with 0 wrong bytes. Procedure: measure the base tiers together; while a base tier fails, drop the failing base tier with the highest aggregate rate and re-measure; then measure each optional tier alone on top of the admitted base (marginal bytes) and admit it if it passes
rules.chuck_rock: admitted static tiers + T001 execution evidence (executed roots through the same two-decoder descent; DMA and admitted data reads from the A1 runs); any static code / execution-data or static data / executed-code overlap masks both
rules.decoders: CPU-owned token decoder + m68k-disasm bb6d839 (traced, walk); Capstone 5.0.6 where m68k-disasm abstains
rules.decompression: sega2asm 78f37b0 decompressors, only formats whose routine signature is detected in the ROM; candidates = lea / PC-relative read targets and pointer-table entries outside code; consumed >= 256 bytes, output >= input, all decoding formats agree on the extent, no overlap with code or another blob
rules.soundness: the labeller with the admitted tiers gives 0 wrong I/c/D (frozen definition; labels over listing-unknown bytes such as .org fill are reported separately) on the committed synthetic fixture, static-only and with each G1 scenario's execution evidence, and the Chuck Rock labels are digest-reproducible
rules.usefulness_and_classes: as ADR 0171: PROCEED when positive cells >= 10%, negative cells >= 2% and >= 50 mixed cells; PARTIAL when positive cells >= 5%; STOP otherwise or when a soundness gate fails; the independent validator binds
rules.wrong_label: predicted I vs truth c/D, c vs I/D, D vs I/c; truth U never counts
